items.title: Denise Morel Interview, 1965-05-07
items.q: He does music of a film, the Brigitte Bardot, and he accompanies Brigitte Bardot when she sings.

ctx.x: Do you know, I don't know how to pronounce it. Claude Boling?

Claude Boling, oh, yes. Claude Boling, he is a wonderful pianist. He is also very, very proud. He has done extraordinary things. I met him when he was 14 years old. He was a little boy. He played piano in the surprise party, in the cassette of his parents, because he was not right. He was already a piano player. And he did his first orchestra, which was already very good, and which was at this moment, in a very New Orleans style, which was practically the same, that the style of Maxime Sorrie, and of Claude…
And, uh... Do you like Johnny Dodds? Oh, very much. Well, what do most people in France, both of the jazz fans, think of Johnny Dodds?
